player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered a loop between the Billiard room, Kitchen, Mudroom, and Garage, repeatedly visiting the same rooms without exploring the unvisited directions (specifically west from Kitchen and east from Garage). I prematurely stopped with "DONE" while unvisited rooms were still accessible. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and directions. When I encounter a room I have visited before, I will immediately check if there are any directions I have not yet taken from that room. I will prioritize moving into unexplored directions (like west from Kitchen or east from Garage) rather than returning to previously visited paths. Only when I have taken every available direction from every room I have visited will I issue "DONE".
